notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Round monetary values only via ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 4x, 3 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0008] Refunds above 500 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0009] Record audit entry for every balance change: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must call ledgerly.audit.record("<past_tense_event>", <entity>_id=..., amount=...) with payment_id=... or invoice_id=... so finance can reconcile the ledger.
  (learned from task E06 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0010] Reject non-positive amounts with non_positive_amount: Validate amounts after rounding and raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount)) when amount <= ZERO, matching payments.authorize.
  (learned from task S01 on ledgerly 2.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Normalize money via to_money and round_money: Always convert incoming monetary values with `to_money(...)` and round with `round_money(...)` from `ledgerly.money` before storing them on models; compare against `ZERO` for sign checks.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0004] Guard mutations with draft status check: Mutating invoice operations must first check `invoice.status != "draft"` and raise `BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")`, matching `issue_invoice`.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Use round_money for half-even cent rounding
item.content: All monetary amounts must be rounded to the cent with ledgerly.money.round_money (ROUND_HALF_EVEN); do not use half-up rounding or hand-rolled quantize calls.

candidate.title: Convert amounts via to_money, reject floats
candidate.content: Convert incoming amounts and rates with ledgerly.money.to_money before arithmetic; it rejects bool/float inputs and raises BillingError, so never call Decimal() directly on user values.

item.title: Raise BillingError with snake_case codes
item.content: Signal invalid input in ledgerly modules by raising ledgerly.errors.BillingError with a short snake_case code (e.g. "invalid_rate") and the offending value as message, matching payments.py and money.py.
